doc: Integration QA (M3-HER-1121, test_qa_threads.gd): warnings and errors the playthrough guards already know about, each handed to its owner as a request task. A message matching `pattern` (a regex) is counted and reported under its task, not failed; anything else fails the guard. Remove a row when its task lands; the guard then holds that kind of message out for good.
capsules_doc: test_qa_capsules.gd: zone file name -> the actors (StandIn's parent) still shown as capsules, and 'battle' -> party members with no battle actor scene. All handed to their owners: M3-HER-1125 (characters: the Act I cast's models), M3-HER-1120 (ui-menus: Liss's battle row; her actor is ready). Remove a name when its model lands; the guard then fails if the capsule comes back. Each zone is checked as it loads and again under every layout variant's flags (Ch9's dawn road: Kerrid at the milestone, act1-chapters' staging of characters' M3-CHR-505 model). 'battle_foes' -> every encounter enemy, spawn, summon and Vowbound with no actor scene, with its owner and task.

unraised.ch02_ate_at_nemes: test_fp_thread reloads Haluna after the tideline win without HalunaStory.begin(), so B02 (Neme's table, which sets it) never plays in the thread; the game plays it on arrival and test_haluna_slice_beats covers it. M2-HER-1128 (slice-polish): play B02 in the thread.
